lead.headline: Harden Drops 51, Passes Kobe
lead.subhead: At 37, James Harden went 15-of-26, 7-of-11 from three and 14-of-14 at the line as Cleveland beat Indiana 128-119. It was his 26th career 50-point game, third-most in NBA history behind only Wilt and Jordan. Age is a number. Output is the answer.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Saturday, the day of Saturn: structure, discipline, the long game. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. No boss, no clock. That's exactly when discipline counts.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go build.

mindset.body: Harden is 37 and just put up 51, passing Kobe. Nobody hands that out. It's built on thousands of reps nobody saw. Saturday is your unseen rep: no office, no quota, just you and the build. Ship one real piece of 7EightMade before noon, then enjoy the fights like someone who already won the day. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday, the day of Saturn: run this right after Morning Charge. It's about 49° and clear at dawn, so take the RipStick finisher outside if you want. Smooth, controlled reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.body: In Indio, Gabriela Fundora kept her flyweight titles and Amari Jones stopped DeAundre Pettus in round 8.
Saturday is Saturn's day, the planet the old astrologers tied to time, limits and discipline. Saturn was feared as the Great Malefic and also honored as the teacher who rewards whoever does the work.
The alchemists' motto: dissolve, then bind. Break the old form down, then rebuild it stronger. It's the same arc as fall down 7, stand up 8.
The 14th-century German mystic taught that the soul meets God 'in the ground' when it lets go of what it clings to. Less grasping, more clarity.

techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: @Texas_Twins_Dad shared a way to say "Hey Grok" on iPhone and have Grok voice chat open, using only built-in iOS features, no extra apps.
techDemo.author: @Texas_Twins_Dad
techDemo.note: No new bookmarks since Nov 17, so this rotates an older real one (posted Oct 25). The full steps are in the post, so the lesson stays general.

lesson.oneLiner: iOS lets you chain a spoken phrase to an app action without installing anything.
beats: The building blocks live in Settings > Accessibility and the Shortcuts app.
A shortcut can open an app straight to a specific action, like voice chat.
Test it with the phone locked and unlocked, since the behavior can differ.
Same idea for the day: cut the steps between the thought and the action.
lesson.takeaway: Fewer taps between intent and action means more gets done.
